title: A Texas teenager started building birdhouses after losing his pet cockatiel; now he has inspired a conservation movement across 20 states
summary_full: After adopting a pet cockatiel, Aamir Tinwala initiated a bird conservation movement focused on building birdhouses to combat habitat loss. His project promotes awareness of local biodiversity while encouraging community members to take an active role in habitat stewardship. Tinwala has personally constructed over 750 shelters and inspired countless others, illustrating how individual efforts can lead to significant environmental benefits.
